title: Phase 6.1 Private Development-Pool Manifest
description: Schema for the curator-controlled PRIVATE development manifest. This file lives OUTSIDE Git in curator-controlled storage, alongside a >=32-byte private random salt. It is the only artifact that maps opaque DEV ids to canonical case ids. It must never be committed, and its canonical ids/salt must never appear in any public/tracked artifact. The public tracked side stores only the aggregate, the opaque manifest_id, and a SALTED commitment = SHA256(salt || canonical_manifest_bytes) — never a plain unsalted digest, which would enable offline enumeration.

manifest_id.description: Opaque handle, not derived from case content.

canonical_id.description: PRIVATE ONLY. Must never appear in any public/tracked artifact.

x_validation_requirements: per-label counts of cases[] must equal aggregate (solid 8, overclaim 15, correlation_vs_causation 2, mechanism_vs_evidence 2).
no canonical case may be holdout-eligible or retired (enforced by the curator against the sealed mapping; not verifiable in-repo).
the public projection (public_projection) must contain NO canonical_id and NO blind/BIAA/holdout fields.
x_public_side: development_pool_public_manifest.json stores only: schema_version, artifact, manifest_id, commitment_algorithm (salted-sha256), commitment_version (v1), commitment, aggregate, status. Never cases[]/canonical_id/salt.
x_commitment: commitment = SHA256(private_random_salt (>=32 bytes) || canonical_serialization(manifest) utf-8). Salt is stored privately outside Git with this manifest and never published. Verify privately with dev_manifest.verify_commitment(manifest, salt, commitment).
